draft.emotion: warm and connected, thinking of the people closest to you
notes: Near-synonym of أُسْرَة (usra), which refers more strictly to the immediate nuclear family, whereas عَائِلَة often includes extended relatives.

senses.definition: A group of people related to each other, especially parents, children, and close relatives.

examples.text: عَائِلَتِي كَبِيرَةٌ وَتَعِيشُ فِي نَفْسِ المَدِينَةِ.
